label: SEV1 — Critical
definition: Confirmed customer data breach, full platform outage, irreversible data loss, or active account takeover with operator confirmation.
escalation: Owner + platform on-call. Legal review for any customer notification BEFORE sending. No public statements without operator sign-off.

label: SEV2 — Major
definition: Major tenant impact, suspected unauthorized access pending confirmation, backup posture in critical state, or widespread degradation.
escalation: Owner + platform team. Engage legal if customer-facing notification likely. Update prospects in active procurement reviews if affected.

label: SEV3 — Minor
definition: Suspicious pattern, repeated SSO failures within a single tenant, abuse spike, vendor security concern, or single-tenant impact.
escalation: Venue owner + platform team during business hours. Document in the timeline and resolve within the target window.

label: SEV4 — Informational
definition: Informational or manual-review item that the operator wants tracked. No customer impact expected.
escalation: Owner discretion. Track in the IncidentResponseCard so the audit trail exists.
